fixtureScrutiny.a: Only setup seeding mutates state (probe encodeEnvelope from validated seeds.json); no src changes; all actions are real UI clicks/taps.
fixtureScrutiny.b: Documented in probe.mjs header, validate-fixtures.ts, seeds.json, evidence.md and results.json.
fixtureScrutiny.c: Every seeded envelope passes the game's full decodeSave/validateSim (validate-fixtures.ts PASS); no invariant weakened or bypassed.
fixtureScrutiny.d: Actions flow through dispatch->applyCommand; localStorage read only as the game's own persistence mirror.

audioBoundary.method: Web Audio API instrumented via addInitScript (ctor + createGain/createDynamicsCompressor/createOscillator/createBufferSource + AudioNode.connect). Master = the gain feeding the compressor; masterLevel read live from the real gain node. Browser equivalent of audio.ts graphSnapshot(); headless cannot listen.
audioBoundary.unitSuite: tests/game/audio.test.ts asserts the full module node table + mute at the same SHA.

findings.detail: Mature fixture holds exactly 10 steel and reserveFloor=10, so sellableAmount(steel)=0; the sell step sells the dearest genuinely-sellable face through its real Max preset + Sell. Carried from #57.
With a machine selected at tutorial>=8 the dock renders the upgrade-branch row; tapping an empty yard cell returns it to rest. Documented one-selection dock model. Carried from #57.

The guided Connect face does not pre-print the belt scrap cost, so the first tap at 0 scrap refuses with a grouped shortfall toast + persistent Last tail; the drone banks scrap and the same primary connects. Used here as the deterministic c2 grouping demonstration. Out of #65 scope to re-price (BELT-001 / #57 finding 4).
